patterns.note: Sections are full-width with generous vertical padding, creating an airy feel, and feature left-aligned text blocks for readability.
A clear typographic hierarchy is established with very large, bold sans-serif headings contrasting with smaller, lighter body text and tiny uppercase labels.
A high-contrast dark theme uses a dominant black background with white text, punctuated by a vibrant neon green as the primary accent color for CTAs and highlights.

The hero's 3D graphic elements exhibit a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the background scroll, creating a sense of depth. Subsequent content sections are revealed with a fade-in and slight upward slide as they enter the viewport.
The primary navigation bar and a persistent cookie consent banner remain fixed to the top and bottom-right of the viewport, respectively, throughout the scroll.
Interactive horizontal scrolling carousels are used for both the 'Services' and 'News' sections, allowing users to explore content by dragging or swiping.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a parallax scrolling effect where the 3D graphic elements move at a slower rate than the page scroll, creating a sense of depth. Subsequent content sections are animated to fade in and translate slightly upwards as they become visible within the viewport, enhancing engagement. The main header and a cookie banner are implemented as sticky elements, maintaining their position at the top and bottom-right of the screen regardless of scroll depth. Interactive horizontal carousels are used for showcasing services and portfolio items, allowing users to navigate content by dragging or swiping. The 'What we do' button incorporates a subtle lottie or video-hero animation for an interactive hover state.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, lighter body text and tiny uppercase labels for context.
design_tokens.radius: subtle (buttons, cookie banner, image cards have a soft, consistent corner radius)
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with significant vertical spacing between major sections and a balanced density within content blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its bold use of a high-contrast dark theme with a vibrant neon green accent, combined with sophisticated 3D graphics and subtle scroll-triggered animations. The integration of horizontal scrolling carousels for services and portfolio items further enhances its modern, interactive, and premium feel, setting it apart from typical agency templates.
